question: Who was the British Prime Minister during the first round table conference in London?
solution:
The correct answer is Ramsay__** MacDonald.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramsay MacDonald**

 
 
• **​**James Ramsay **MacDonald FRS** was a British politician.
 
• He served as** Prime Minister of the United Kingdom**, the first who belonged to the Labour Party.
 
• He thought it important to address the issue of constitutional reforms in India.
 
• For this purpose, he organized a conference in London and invited representatives from all the parties and Indian states.
 
• This conference came to be popularly known as the First Round Table Conference.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First Round Table Conference**

 
 
• The First Round Table Conference was held between **November 1930 **and **January 1931** in **London**.
 
• There were increasing demands of granting dominion status to India among a certain section of the British polity.
 
• In India, the freedom movement was in full swing with its demand for swaraj or self-rule spearheaded by the charismatic Gandhi.
 
• Participants in the First Round Table Conference
 
 
• **58 political leaders from British India.**
 
• **16 delegates from the native princely states.**
 
• **16 delegates from the three British political parties.**
 
 
 
• It was for the first time that the Indians and the British were meeting as ‘equals’.
